description: This file implements hostname utility functions for the quiche project, including hostname canonicalization, validation of SNI, and hostname normalization.

classes.name: QuicheHostnameUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for hostname validation and normalization.

methods.name: CanonicalizeHost
methods.description: Canonicalizes a hostname string, returning a normalized form.

methods.name: IsHostCharAlphanumeric
methods.description: Checks if a character is alphanumeric (a-z, 0-9).

methods.name: IsCanonicalizedHostCompliant
methods.description: Checks if a canonicalized hostname complies with specific rules.

methods.name: QuicheHostnameUtils::IsValidSNI
methods.description: Validates if a given SNI hostname is valid according to custom rules.

methods.name: QuicheHostnameUtils::NormalizeHostname
methods.description: Normalizes a hostname by canonicalizing and removing trailing dots.
